statusLine.benefit: With the status line configured, this CLI's tabs show their status, the “waiting” bar when it asks for permission to use a tool, and the context meter with the exact window. Without it there's no way to know: the CLI doesn't leave it in any other file.
statusLine.checkHint: The app also notices on its own within a couple of seconds.
statusLine.copyTitle: Copy the line to the clipboard
statusLine.mergeHint: Merge it with what the file below already has, without replacing it: if it already has braces, add only the <kbd>statusLine</kbd> key.
statusLine.runsEverywhere: With the line in place, every CLI session runs it, including the ones you open outside the app, and it needs <kbd>node</kbd> in the PATH.
statusLine.scriptHint: It only saves the status, model and tokens of each conversation, in the app's folder. It doesn't save your email, your quota or the cost, which the CLI also passes to it, and it doesn't print anything: the CLI's own line stays as it is.
statusLine.title: {{agent}} status line
statusLine.whereHint: The app doesn't touch that file: you edit it.

vault.button.on: Local copy: on. See the status and the folder
vault.dialog.activateExistingHint: The folder already has a copy. Once on, it completes it and keeps it up to date.
vault.dialog.activateExistingTitle: The folder already has a copy: turning it on completes it
vault.dialog.activateMeasuredHint: Copies everything measured and, after that, every session that changes and stays quiet for a minute.
vault.dialog.activateMeasuredTitle: Copies what was measured now and, after that, every session that changes
vault.dialog.changeDirTitle: Choose another folder. What was copied gets copied there; this one stays untouched

vault.dialog.openFolderTitle: Open the folder in the system's file explorer
vault.dialog.turnOffHint: Turning it off doesn't delete anything: what was copied stays in the folder.

vault.mark.copyTitle: The CLI's history no longer has this session. The local copy opens, in Markdown.
vault.mark.partialTitle: Only the summary and the documents were recovered: the conversation's content is encrypted.

vault.previousDir: The previous folder was left untouched: {{dir}}
vault.privacy: It keeps the same as each CLI's history —messages, tool inputs and results, images— in a folder of yours. If you put it in a synced folder or in a repository, all that travels with it.
workspace.connectFailed: Couldn't connect to the local server. Open the URL it printed at startup again.
